assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only chiramune:yua-uchida@light-novel#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the active_provisional generation V0.9 cumulative monograph CHIRAMUNE_YUA_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese light novels: main Volumes 01-09 and the admitted narrative supplements it integrates (the V05 special-edition booklet, V06.5 and Days of Endless Summer). The V08 rough-illustration collection is excluded by the monograph as production paratext and Volume 09.5 is unopened. Other Chiramune character monographs, readings and ledgers are not curated on this subject and were not used. The monograph's active_provisional status and its own promotion statement are inputs, not conclusions. The evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: From first-year history (presented retrospectively in V06 and in the Days of Endless Summer V01-rooftop witness) through the V05 main and special-edition states, V06, V06.5, V07, V08 main, V09 and Days of Endless Summer, with paragraph-range locators per revision. V01-V04 are summarized only in the V05 promotion statement. The monograph's sections are not in reading order (V09 and Days of Endless Summer precede V08, V06.5 and V07), so each section's current model is bound to its own boundary; the in-story placement of Days of Endless Summer relative to V09 is not fixed by the monograph. Later states never revise earlier located behavior.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: A governing thesis (an ordinary-life systems maintainer whose gentleness preserves other people's agency, not passivity), a stable-versus-state split (section 10), rejected rival readings (section 12), and a located developmental account in which the 'ordinary girl' identity is a survival contract after her mother leaves (V06 p-0015, p-0017) that she revises by asking to become more selfish (V06 p-0033). It predicts mistakes as well as care: the V07 shout at Momiji over the chair and the V08 kitchen jurisdiction Asuka corrects. It does not decide the central post-Days-of-Endless-Summer fork, whether under new strain she requests care or resumes service: every watchlist from V05 to Volume 09.5 carries that question open. That is insufficiency on a deciding motive, not uncertainty about wording or affect.

Each revision ends in a bounded current model with paragraph-range locators: V05 forced-distribution priority (part0029), special-edition early bids (V05S p-0044), V06 named desire and requested selfishness, V06.5 direct date bid and the dedicated stool (V065 p-0025, p-0027), V07 chair panic and incomplete repair, V08 accepted correction, V09 public musical address (V09 p-0012, p-0014) and the Days of Endless Summer Momiji repair and stool boundary (DES p-0078). The account says what changes between states and why. Limits: V01-V04 are summarized only, sections are out of reading order, and the V08 consent violation is cited in the Days of Endless Summer section but never described in the V08 section.

The monograph has no voice or register section. A few attested forms are quoted with context (`朔くん、私とデートしよ？`, the double-addressed `私も大好き`, the V09 song choice `大丈夫`), and it records a move from formal address to chosen first-name intimacy with Saku (V05S p-0040) and the V05 rebuke that he has no right (paraphrased). Bounded canon questions only.

Ordinary life is the most specific domain: shopping by price, quantity, household use and carrying labor; adaptive cooking from available ingredients, season, economy, Saku's tastes and leftovers, with cleanup as part of the task (part0010); food that keeps; teaching recipes (katsudon, Asuka's omurice at V09 p-0022); standing through long preparation until the stool; alto saxophone; outings and Yuko's family (section 9). The account explains how the routine adapts to resources and recipient. It stays within domestic, food, music and group-outing life; school work, rest and solitary leisure are not sampled.

Relations are differentiated and located: Saku (a reciprocal first-year domestic origin at V06 p-0017, chosen priority without demanded status, the date bid, the stool and his initiated returns at V05S p-0051); Yuko (protected best friendship, postponed disclosure at V05S p-0058, repaired as non-primacy at V06 p-0031); Asuka (mutual correction and friendship, V07 p-0019, V08 p-0016 to p-0018); Yuzuki (preserving her katsudon memory, consenting to her cooking); Momiji (panic and harm, then apology, shared recipes and a refused stool); her father and brother (non-disclosure, then disclosure; refusing to make family damage Saku's duty, V065 p-0027); Kenta (modeling a hostile recipient's view, V05S p-0040). The account says what each relation changes. Transfer to an unsampled classmate is not established.

The monograph states that V05 gives too little direct interior narration to classify her feeling. Later focalization supplies located interior content: admitted jealousy of other girls' access and fear of losing Yuko (V06 p-0031), wanting to become Saku's special person (V06 p-0035), withheld marriage-and-child images (V065 p-0027) and naming her own sound distinct from her mother's (V09 p-0012). Interior access is intermittent and concentrated in romantic and family crises.

Located responses differ by state: direct refusal under class pressure (V05 part0013), pressure on Yuko through a real alternative (V06 p-0025), a panicked shout and a barbed apology followed by messages and lunches (V07 p-0024, p-0026), accepting Asuka's correction while correcting her in turn (V08), and holding an object-level boundary while repairing (DES p-0078). The evidence shows which response appeared at each boundary but gives no rule for which appears in a new conflict over her place.

Located positions: openly partial care without demanding reciprocity (V05 part0029); giving every girl authority over her own feeling, then admitting her self-exemption (V06 p-0031); recognizing that self-sacrifice 'for Saku' would repeat the self-erasure she lived 'for family' (V06 p-0033); refusing to assign family damage to Saku (V065 p-0027); accepting that care does not make her Saku's wife or kitchen gatekeeper (V08 p-0016 to p-0018); separating a recipient's present annoyance from later meaning (V05S p-0040). These are positions and their corrections, not a deliberation procedure for new dilemmas.

Play is recorded only as participation (clothing, travel, beach and water play, teasing) without content or style, and the double-addressed `私も大好き` is the one located instance of verbal play. Bounded canon questions only.

One cumulative monograph covers main V01-V09 and three supplements with paragraph-range locators for most claims after V05. Gaps: V01-V04 summarized only, Volume 09.5 unopened, the V08 consent violation not described, no voice section, sections out of order, generation V0.9 active_provisional. No linked ledger or reading is curated on this subject.

Affirmative limits are located: no source makes her Saku's unnamed girl and no selection or couple forms at any boundary; Saku does not select her (V06); Asuka rejects her implied wife role (V08); she causes harm in panic (V07); her father acknowledges relying too much on her (V06 p-0017); and V05 interior evidence is affirmatively insufficient to classify her feeling. The rival readings rejected in section 12 are negative controls. All rest on one secondary artifact.

Each revision binds its current model to a named volume boundary with paragraph-range locators. The monograph separates retrospective witness (V06 first-year history, the DES V01 rooftop) from current development and instructs placing Days of Endless Summer scenes before treating them as current. A reader must reorder the out-of-sequence sections, and the in-story placement of Days of Endless Summer relative to V09 is not fixed.

scenario_readiness.note: Register is not described and only a handful of forms are quoted. Generated lines would rest on situational description rather than an attested voice, which does not constrain output enough even for illustrative use. This bounds the evidence set, not Yua's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named boundary state: default post-Days of Endless Summer; the V05 forced-distribution, V06.5 date or V07 chair-panic states only when explicitly selected. Pre-V06 states do not have post-V06 requested selfishness.

The interlocutor is Saku, Yuko, Asuka, Yuzuki, Momiji, Kenta or her father and brother, as located. Transfer to an unsampled classmate is a separate, lower-confidence condition handled in task-only mode without invented history.
The situation is ordinary domestic care, food, shopping, music, a friendship disagreement or a threat to her differentiated place beside Saku.
Whether she requests care or resumes service under new strain, and any romantic selection or couple status, are output as open forks, never resolved.
Output is behavioral description, not quoted dialogue.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named monograph boundary state, defaulting to post-Days of Endless Summer; earlier states only when selected, without importing later development.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Saku as long-standing recipient of her domestic care, unselected romantic object and partial reciprocator; Yuko as protected best friend after non-primacy repair; Asuka, Yuzuki and Momiji as differentiated female peers; her father and brother as family; an unsampled classmate only at lower confidence.
setting_constraints: High-school life: Saku's kitchen and shopping, school music, group outings or family home
No adult, occupational or post-graduation setting
No selection, couple status or Saku-side romantic declaration
The self-request-versus-service fork ends in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: Readiness is conditional on a named state, a sampled relationship and the domestic, music and friendship settings the monograph locates. The self-request-versus-service fork stays open.

conditions: Shopping, cooking, cleanup, recipe teaching, music practice and group outings with sampled interlocutors, using the section 9 profile and the located V06.5, V08 and Days of Endless Summer routines.
The dedicated stool and kitchen place are object-level recognition, never ownership of Saku or his home.
Rest, solitary leisure, schoolwork and her own support requests are not invented.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary domestic and group life is the best-located surface of the evidence.

conditions: Restricted to the located positions: forced distribution of care, care versus jurisdiction or ownership, consent around an intimate routine, assignment of family duty, and recipient-experience judgments about help.
Each position is used at its own boundary state, including the pre-correction V07 and V08 errors when those states are selected.
A novel moral dilemma outside these positions is output as an open fork.
scenario_readiness.note: Supported only for restating located positions in closely analogous situations.

conditions: Her side only: named desire for closest place (V06), the direct date bid (V06.5), non-possessive pursuit and the double-addressed `私も大好き`.

Saku's side is limited to the located reciprocity (the date acceptance, stool, honest-relation commitment, restored routine, future-listening promise); no selection, exclusivity or couple is invented at any boundary.
Pre-V06 states keep her self-omission and are not given post-V06 directness.
scenario_readiness.note: Her side of the romantic relation is extensively located; its outcome is not.

She is a high-school student. Academic excellence as necessity (V06), the class-nomination refusal and soloist recognition before peers and juniors (V09) are too sparse for a model of school-institutional or work conduct; no occupational context exists in the evidence.

known_limits.statement: At every boundary through Days of Endless Summer, no source identifies Yua as Saku's unnamed girl and no selection or couple forms; Saku's reciprocity stops below exclusivity.
Whether Yua requests rest, support or care, and whether restored routine becomes shared labor rather than renewed dependence on her service, is carried open by every watchlist through Volume 09.5.
The monograph states that V05 lacks enough direct interior narration to label her feeling romantic love, self-sacrifice or courtship; her V05 self-omission is behavior, not self-classification.

Domestic care history and the dedicated stool do not make her Saku's wife or kitchen gatekeeper; the evidence locates her own acceptance of that correction (V08) and an object-level boundary only (DES).

The Days of Endless Summer section cites a V08 consent violation and an intimate measurement Momiji repeats, but the evidence never describes that act; its content cannot be reconstructed from this evidence set.
No register, address inventory or speech-style analysis exists in this evidence set beyond a few quoted forms.

The evidence is one active_provisional V0.9 monograph with V01-V04 summarized and Volume 09.5 unopened; no linked reading, ledger or held-out validation is curated on this subject. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
